content:
Successful HWPX automation achieved through comprehensive XML placeholder replacement, layout cache removal, and precise age calculation logic.
The process involved iterating through all XML files in the HWPX package to replace placeholders and stripping <hp:lineSegArray> elements to prevent rendering artifacts. Age calculation for '만 나이' was implemented by comparing birth dates to visit dates and formatting as '(<N>세)'. The final package was validated by using zipfile.ZIP_STORED for the mimetype file and ZIP_DEFLATED for all other components.
